result_text:
I changed `all_files.zip` to package the scope file lists under names derived from the configured aspect names. The `reports` module compiles. I didn't run any tests or try a renamed config, so the fix is untested.

The change is in `DataExporter.java` in the `reports` module. The `all_files.zip` block no longer uses the five fixed `aspect_*.txt` literals. It now builds each entry name with `DataExportUtils.getAspectFileListFileName(...)`, the same call that writes the loose text files. It uses the main, test, generated, build-and-deploy and other aspects, in that order.

With the default config the entries are the same as before. With the aspect renamed to "buildAndDeployment", the fourth entry becomes `aspect_buildAndDeployment.txt`. The zip is written, and `git-history.zip` follows when `git-history.txt` exists, because the exception no longer aborts the export before that point.
